posts.name: Glasshand
posts.tagline: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac
posts.description: Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

posts.name: Living Brain
posts.tagline: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
posts.description: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

posts.name: Rerun
posts.tagline: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
posts.description: Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

posts.name: Pushary for Teams
posts.tagline: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents
posts.description: When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.

posts.name: Clocknext
posts.tagline: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents
posts.description: Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

posts.name: Bridge
posts.tagline: Video conferencing for the agentic era
posts.description: This launch marks a new era for Bridge: one agentic meeting platform replacing the fragmented meeting stack. Bridge now brings scheduling pages, automatic preparation, video conferencing, live intelligence, AI notetaking, agentic workflows, and structured memory into one connected experience for people and agents. At the center of this launch is a new kind of video conferencing built for customizable AI agents to join and participant in meetings.

posts.name: Maritime
posts.tagline: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way
posts.description: Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

posts.name: Tao Browser
posts.tagline: Private browser with a separate login for every company
posts.description: Tao Browser keeps each company, client or project in its own space with its own cookies and logins. Lock tabs with Face ID or Touch ID, block ads and trackers on your device, import from Arc. No account, no telemetry. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac (beta).

posts.name: Polylane for Google Cloud
posts.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps
posts.description: Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

posts.name: Stitch.ai
posts.tagline: Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more
posts.description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

posts.name: Rainbrand
posts.tagline: The brand layer for agents
posts.description: Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files. Give your agents the guidance and assets they need for marketing campaigns, websites, slides, email, video, and more. Keep that context current as your brands evolve. Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or build it into your product through the API.

posts.name: Wingmen
posts.tagline: Agentic outreach with real intent data
posts.description: Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for founders, B2B teams and agencies.

posts.name: Tencent Hy4
posts.tagline: Tencent’s flagship model learns to see and use a computer
posts.description: Hy4 is Tencent’s latest flagship model, aimed at office tasks, financial analysis and game development. New since the preview, per Tencent: visual understanding for charts and images, and computer use across command line and graphical interfaces, with training on Blender and CAD. Tencent says the internal hallucination rate fell from 12.95% to 7.2%. Available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, OpenRouter and Tencent apps. Weights are promised in the coming days.

posts.name: Okapi
posts.tagline: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos
posts.description: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. It is built for developers whose apps and agents depend on third-party APIs. These APIs change all the time, and one breaking change can take your app down in production. Okapi keeps your code up to date with every API it calls, so your app keeps working and your team stops chasing changelogs. Okapi works with any API and is 100% free.

posts.name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
posts.tagline: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM
posts.description: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

posts.name: AI Employees by Easy-Peasy.AI
posts.tagline: Hire an AI team that splits the work and asks before sending
posts.description: Hire AI employees by role: a Chief of Staff, analyst, designer, support rep and 15 more, or describe your own. Add your website and the team reads it. Brief everyone in a group chat: the lead splits the work, teammates reply in a thread and you get one write-up. By default, emails, calendar changes and app actions wait for your OK. Each employee has a memory, its own computer and routines that run on a schedule or when an email arrives. You can even call them. Your first employee is free.

posts.name: FounderMail
posts.tagline: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain
posts.description: Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

posts.name: TextKit
posts.tagline: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API
posts.description: A simple SMS api that just works. Integrates in 100+ services including claude and chatGPT. AI-assisted campaign registrations. Human support. Also - 50% cheaper than Twilio

posts.name: Cosyra
posts.tagline: Launch and steer agents on your machines from your phone
posts.description: Cosyra is a mobile coding tool for iPhone and Android. Run any agent on your phone from a cloud Ubuntu terminal without managing your own VPS.

posts.name: Pinku
posts.tagline: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac
posts.description: Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

posts.name: Zerg Client
posts.tagline: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes
posts.description: Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

posts.name: Bambu Lab H3C
posts.tagline: Print multi-material projects faster and easier
posts.description: Bambu Lab H3C is a next-generation 3D printer that makes multi-material printing faster and easier. Its nine-tool Swaptek system switches materials in as little as six seconds, with less filament waste and no repeated loading. Combine colors, rigid and flexible materials, and different nozzle sizes in a single print. With automatic calibration, integrated filament storage and drying, and support for soft TPU, H3C lets you focus on what you're making, not managing your printer.

posts.name: Paws
posts.tagline: Meet strangers through their cats, behind frosted glass
posts.description: I’ve always found something quietly beautiful about brief encounters with strangers. Paws is a tiny room of other people’s cats, seen through frosted glass. Maybe one wanders over and presses a paw to your fingertip. Nothing to win. Just stay a while. 🐾

posts.name: ChatNest
posts.tagline: Folders and a prompt library for your AI chats
posts.description: Save AI chats into folders with a title and summary, search them live, and reuse prompt templates with variables via Ctrl+K or //. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and more, in 55 languages. Local-first; Free needs no sign-in.

posts.name: Keel
posts.tagline: A native macOS client for Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly
posts.description: Keel is a free, open-source Mac app for Redis 6+, Valkey and Dragonfly. Browse millions of keys with SCAN only, edit every core type, use a redis-cli-style console and read server health. Read-only connections and typed confirmations keep production safe.

posts.name: Vibeconferencing
posts.tagline: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call
posts.description: Vibeconferencing puts your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a local model) into your call as a participant, with a face and a voice. It hears the room, talks back, and builds on a shared whiteboard while you talk. Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, Telegram and phone calls. Free and open source.

posts.name: MCPCore
posts.tagline: Build and host MCP servers with no-code workflows
posts.description: MCPCore lets you build MCP servers without code. Drop steps on a canvas, add loops and error branches, test live in the playground and publish a secure endpoint for Claude, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. Or import your OpenAPI.

posts.name: CC Auto Review
posts.tagline: macOS app that reviews GitHub PRs w/ your local Claude Code
posts.description: A macOS app that reviews GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code. AI findings sit beside the diff, and you accept, reject or edit each one before posting. Every PR gets a 0–100 risk score, and an optional autopilot clears routine reviews while handing risky PRs to you with nothing posted. No clone and no API key to set up: it uses your existing gh and claude. Free and open source (MIT).

posts.name: Nock
posts.tagline: A notch for Windows, in 1 MB of Rust
posts.description: A native notch and top bar for Windows (Linux preview). Media, quick tasks, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, power and little animated scenes live at the top of your screen. About 1 MB, about 0% CPU idle, no Electron. Free and MIT licensed. The demo on the site is playable.

posts.name: DearCameo
posts.tagline: Social network where only the dead have accounts — DearMate
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Every account on DearCameo belongs to someone who has died — checked against Wikidata, so nobody living gets one. You pick the person, write their post, and the people who actually knew them pile into the comments within a minute. Tap any face to answer as them.

posts.name: Seamcult
posts.tagline: A pattern design tool for the LLM era ('paper' for patterns)
posts.description: Give any MCP agent — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral — a photo, a paper pattern or a brief, and it drafts on a mannequin built from your measurements while you watch. Or rework what you have: refit it to another size, split a piece, add a pocket, move a seam — just ask. Seamcult audits the geometry, so the agent works from facts, not guesses. Sketch a fix on the canvas and the agent gets it as an image. Print on A4 at home, export PLT or DXF, or share a read-only link. Free in early access.

posts.name: SafetyClip
posts.tagline: A clipboard manager for Mac that keeps secrets secret
posts.description: SafetyClip is a clipboard manager for Mac. It saves everything you copy, so you can press ⌃⌘V in any app, search, and paste it again. But a clipboard history also collects your passwords and API keys. So SafetyClip spots them as you copy them and locks them behind Touch ID. A copied API key comes off the clipboard right away, so it isn't there for other apps to read, and you can't paste it into an AI chat by mistake. Everything stays on your Mac. $8 once, full Swift source included.

posts.name: Scrollsnacks
posts.tagline: Launch videos, broken down second by second
posts.description: Launch videos broken into timed hook, problem, solution, feature, proof and CTA sections. Search them by brand or section, or from your AI tools via MCP.

posts.name: backlane
posts.tagline: Manage marketplaces in ChatGPT and Claude via MCP
posts.description: Bring Mirakl-powered marketplaces into ChatGPT and Claude, with US operators such as Best Buy US, Lowe’s and Nordstrom in the marketplace catalog. Also supports OTTO Market and Kaufland. Ask about stock, ad performance, offers, orders and import reports. Free during the limited open beta. Coming soon: Walmart, Target and Amazon.

posts.name: SnapTiles
posts.tagline: Build with magnetic tiles in 3D, free in your browser
posts.description: Magnetic tiles in 3D, free in the browser. Drag tiles out and they snap edge to edge like the real ones, and gravity knocks down a roof that wouldn't hold. Crash it, rebuild it, or start from a ready-made build. If you use Claude, it can also rebuild a tile build from an Instagram or YouTube video.

posts.name: Stenograf
posts.tagline: Private AI meeting notes that run on your computer
posts.description: Stenograf records calls without a meeting bot, then transcribes, summarizes and searches them on your computer. Supported Mac and Windows. Ask questions across meetings and check the cited transcript passages. Your recordings and complete transcripts stay local.

posts.name: Ada By Adalo
posts.tagline: Making an app as easy as sending a text!
posts.description: Since 2019, we have built more than 3 million apps with Adalo. Along the way, they asked for two things: apps that scale and run faster, and an easier way to build them. So we built Ada from the ground up. Describe your app in a few words, and Ada builds the real thing: the screens, sign-in, and a database designed around your app, built to scale. Payments connect in a few steps, the Publishing Studio gets apps store-ready, and code export means what you make stays yours.

posts.name: Wow Keywords
posts.tagline: Keyword research and ASO for App Store and Google Play
posts.description: Desktop ASO app for Mac and Windows. Track keywords in 52 countries, let AI rewrite your listing and screenshots in 50 languages, upload to App Store Connect or Google Play in one click. Runs on your Claude Code or Codex. Pay once, no subscription.

posts.name: Arcline
posts.tagline: Open-source diagram canvas you and your agent edit together.
posts.description: Arcline is a friendly, local-first diagram canvas for architecture and flow diagrams. Draw by hand, write diagrams as code with Mermaid, D2, Structurizr or OpenFlow DSL, or hand the canvas to your AI agent over MCP. Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex can read and edit the same document — every change is one undo step. No account, no cloud. Free and open source.

posts.name: Strive & Seek
posts.tagline: For those brave enough to keep searching for what’s next.
posts.description: Strive & Seek creates relatable merch that's built to be worn for those always striving to create what’s next – founder, startup employee and corporate innovator alike. Each design is inspired by real life startup and innovation teams, where ambition and the desire to create something new lives and embodies the spirit of “f*ck it, ship it”. Because done is always better than perfect.

posts.name: SaliencyLab
posts.tagline: Score any ad against 10,000 real ads, before you spend
posts.description: Test your ad creative with AI before you spend. Upload one ad, get 5 KPI scores in 90 seconds, benchmarked against real ads. No surveys, no waiting.

posts.name: Adaver
posts.tagline: Turn any image or idea into an editable SVG. Open beta
posts.description: Drop in any image and Adaver turns it into a clean, editable SVG in milliseconds. Don't have one? Describe it. Need a change? Say it, and nothing else moves. Export to SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF or PNG. We're in open beta, so tell us what breaks.

posts.name: Peekat Email
posts.tagline: Gmail & Outlook notifier extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox
posts.description: Peekat Email is a free browser extension (Gmail notifier) for Chrome, Edge and Firefox that checks every Gmail account signed in to your browser and the Outlook.com accounts you add, notifies you only about mail that needs you, and puts sign-in codes one click away.

posts.name: LiquidPhotos
posts.tagline: Photos that flow into each other, for SwiftUI
posts.description: Cross-fades are the default photo transition, and they waste the moment. LiquidPhotos is an open source SwiftUI package that morphs one photo into the next: every pixel travels to its place in the new photo. Same-scene photos align first, so a closer shot plays like walking up to it. It renders on device in one Metal pass at up to 120 Hz, no generative model, no network. The whole integration is one line: LiquidAlbum($photos). MIT, Swift 6, iOS 17+, on Swift Package Manager.

posts.name: Remedy
posts.tagline: AI feed filter: type what you don't want to see
posts.description: Remedy is an AI feed filter for Chrome on desktop. Type what you don't want to see in plain words, like "no rage bait" or "nothing about the finale", and it removes matching posts, comments, images and videos on X, YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok and any site you add. Unlike muted words, it filters by meaning, not keywords. Removed posts just disappear, and a counter on the toolbar icon shows how many. Posts are checked by AI models with zero data retention.

posts.name: LaunchDB
posts.tagline: Launch free. Get discovered by makers.
posts.description: LaunchDB is a free Product Hunt alternative for indie makers and SaaS founders. Launch your product, get discovered, and climb a fresh weekly leaderboard. Community upvotes decide the rankings, and the top three products earn badges and featured placement. New week. New products. Your next chance to get noticed.

posts.name: pourquoi.app
posts.tagline: A mindful pause before opening your apps
posts.description: Every time you open an app you picked, pourquoi.app asks why. You answer in one tap, then decide whether to carry on. Nothing gets blocked. Your answers show where your time really goes. Free on iPhone and Android, no ads.

posts.name: Electros LaunchPad
posts.tagline: Turn your machine into a private AI cloud
posts.description: One-click local LLMs matched to your hardware, VMs with cloud-init and 60+ self-hosted apps (OpenClaw, n8n, Open WebUI...) free and ready with just one click, all wired to your models via an OpenAI-compatible API. For Mac and NVIDIA workstations. Enable your Hybrid AI with Electros launchpad, get 14-day free trial, no card. Only 200 founding licenses: pay once, get updates for life. Product Hunt members get an extra discount.

posts.name: Tellers Free Video Editor for AI Agents
posts.tagline: Edit with Claude or Codex. Preview live. Fine-tune by hand.
posts.description: Give Claude Code or Codex a video editor you can use together, no download. Combine real footage, motion graphics, titles, transitions, masking, and tracking on a frame-perfect timeline. Preview changes live, adjust the edit yourself, and export locally. Free, with no Tellers account or footage uploads required. Powered by the open-source timeline engine behind Tellers. Just ask your agent: “Create my video with tellers.ai/skills”.

posts.name: Delulu Bio - Your free link in bio
posts.tagline: Your link in bio, minus the paywall and the loading screen
posts.description: Delulu Bio is a free link-in-bio page for creators, communities and small businesses. Add links, YouTube/Spotify/Maps embeds that play in place, shoppable product picks, WhatsApp/Discord join cards, contact forms with an inbox, and password or 18+ gated links. 5 themes, 9 fonts (Devanagari too), up to 3 pages per account, and privacy-friendly analytics with no IPs stored. Server-rendered, so it loads instantly from any app. Free for everyone.

posts.name: NitroMTA
posts.tagline: The open-source Amazon SES replacement
posts.description: Nitrosend's mail delivery engine, open sourced. NitroMTA is a self-hosted engine that speaks the Amazon SES v2 API: keep your SES code, change the endpoint, and send from your own IPs and domains. New IPs warm up receiver by receiver, and nitromta doctor checks every DNS record a receiver looks at. In our published benchmark, on the same AWS bare-metal server with every message on disk before it was accepted, it sustained 3.16× KumoMTA's throughput and 4.11× Postfix's. Rust, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: HelpCenter.io for AI agents
posts.tagline: AI agents theme, integrate and set up your help center
posts.description: Let Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent theme your help center, integrate deeply the AI widget and FAQ sections into your website or app, and set up the structure and content end to end. Staged changes are reviewable in the workspace where your team co-edits live (available on request) and publishes. Move an existing help center with a simple prompt. Product Hunt offer: a free year in exchange for continuous feedback to help shape the agentic experience, or 30% off. Claimable through our website.

posts.name: LowerPlane
posts.tagline: Multi-framework compliance for businesses and enterprises.
posts.description: LowerPlane automates 70-90% of compliance work across SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI-DSS — audit-ready in 30 days.

posts.name: AVP Cloud
posts.tagline: 99.8% less CI, 55% less tokens (yes it's real)
posts.description: Built to replace Git, faster and better, with performance gains that grow exponentially as the number of agents increases.

posts.name: Rebrand MCP
posts.tagline: Real brand references so your app doesn’t look vibe-coded
posts.description: Building got easy. Branding didn’t: ask your AI to design your product and it reaches for the same fonts and colors as everyone else. Rebrand MCP gives it close to 800 hand-picked brand identities and 15,000 shots to look at first, inside Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable and Bolt. Find a typeface, a palette or a logo direction in work that shipped, then build on it or use it to brief your image model. In ChatGPT, attach a picture to find shots that look like it.

posts.name: Cadence
posts.tagline: The pill reminder shaped by the people who use it
posts.description: Medication reminders for iPhone and Apple Watch. Unlimited meds free, Critical Alerts that ring through silent, refill tracking, widgets and a doctor report. Pro is one payment, no subscription. 68 updates since February, many from user ideas.

posts.name: The UI Index
posts.tagline: See how 1,700 websites designed the same screen
posts.description: A free library of real website screens. Login, pricing, checkout, search and 18 more screen types from 1,700 live sites, on desktop and mobile, with every element marked in place. Filter by sector, language, typeface or colour, and follow sign-up and checkout flows step by step. No account needed.

posts.name: XFlog
posts.tagline: Your X followers and interactions, in a self-hosted log
posts.description: An open-source X activity tracker and Python library. Record follows/unfollows and opt-in likes, replies and mentions. Explore constellations or a grouped journal, and save threads on demand. Your history stays in SQLite on your machine. Run with pip, uv or Docker Compose. Live X API usage costs extra.

posts.name: Musa TTS
posts.tagline: Offline AI Text to Speech & Voice Cloning Software
posts.description: MusaTTS is a desktop app for Windows and Mac that turns text into natural speech, clones a voice from a 3–10 second sample, and dubs videos into other languages. The voice engines run on your own computer.

posts.name: ISO 29148 Revision Checker
posts.tagline: What applies and when
posts.description: The ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 requirements record in plain words, the public revision record, a free readiness check, a USD 149 kit and a USD 19 watch.

posts.name: TablesForAgents
posts.tagline: Simple tables for agents
posts.description: Keep trips, expenses, job applications, and other everyday lists in one place across your AI assistants. Just send tablesforagents.com to your favorite AI assistant—it’ll guide you through the setup. Your assistants can read and update the same shared tables, while you can see and manage everything in a spreadsheet-style web app.

posts.name: Musa TTS
posts.tagline: Offline AI Text to Speech & Voice Cloning Software
posts.description: MusaTTS is a desktop app for Windows and Mac that turns text into natural speech, clones a voice from a 3–10 second sample, and dubs videos into other languages. The voice engines run on your own computer.

posts.name: ASIC Market Integrity Rules Checker
posts.tagline: The amended ASIC market integrity rules
posts.description: The amended ASIC market integrity rules, rule by rule: 19 duties, the evidence to keep and the 17 March 2028 start date. Free scope check; kit USD 799.

posts.name: GetFreePlugins.com
posts.tagline: Free AI WordPress Plugins Directory
posts.description: Discover our selection of free AI plugins for WordPress, hand-picked and reviewed by humans. Some offer unlimited usage, all support BYOK (Bring Your Own Key), allowing you to start using them immediately on your website for free.

posts.name: ISO 29148 Revision Checker
posts.tagline: What applies and when
posts.description: The ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 requirements record in plain words, the public revision record, a free readiness check, a USD 149 kit and a USD 19 watch.

posts.name: ShopCutout
posts.tagline: Free Product Photo Background Remover & Bulk Export
posts.description: Remove backgrounds from product photos for free. Export transparent PNGs, white-background JPGs and marketplace sizes, one image or a ZIP batch.

posts.name: linkz.io
posts.tagline: The link in bio that answers "When are you free?"
posts.description: Customers want to know one thing: when are you free? linkz.io puts the answer at the top of one page at linkz.io/yourname, straight from your own Google, Apple or Outlook calendar. They book there and then, with a deposit if you want one, paid into your own payment account. We never take a cut. Add quotes with photos, invoices, gift vouchers, class passes, all your links and socials, and QR codes you can change after printing. Free forever. Pro when you want more.

posts.name: Dead Wake
posts.tagline: Co-op zombie survival on a cruise ship, free in your browser
posts.description: Hold back the dead round after round on the MS Aurelia Serene, restore power, send the Mayday and get your crew off the ship. Up to four players with one invite link and voice chat. Runs in a desktop browser, nothing to install. Built live on stream with Claude.

posts.name: Reliure
posts.tagline: Your reading life, bound together.
posts.description: Reliure is a free reading tracker for iPhone. Scan your books, log your pages, keep notes and ratings, and see your reading stats. No account, no ads.

posts.name: Bel Masri
posts.tagline: Speak the Egyptian Arabic you grew up hearing
posts.description: Bel Masri teaches the Egyptian Arabic people speak in Cairo, not the formal Arabic of textbooks. Native audio on every word, hearing and saying practised as two skills, and review timed so a word comes back right before you'd forget it. iPhone and Android.

posts.name: XFlog
posts.tagline: Your X followers and interactions, in a self-hosted log
posts.description: An open-source X activity tracker and Python library. Record follows/unfollows and opt-in likes, replies and mentions. Explore constellations or a grouped journal, and save threads on demand. Your history stays in SQLite on your machine. Run with pip, uv or Docker Compose. Live X API usage costs extra.

posts.name: indiehackers.lol
posts.tagline: Bid for a spot on the indie hacker leaderboard
posts.description: Put an X profile on a public indie hacker board ranked by bids. New listings start at $5; existing handles pay only the difference when raising their bid. Someone can outbid you at any time, and bids are final. Browse the board and rules before paying.

posts.name: Frapiro
posts.tagline: EMDR planning, sessions and notes
posts.description: A workspace for trained EMDR therapists to organise targets and readiness, use therapist-controlled stimulation tools, and review session notes before signing. Explore the preparation, session-controls and draft-note tour without an account using clearly fictional data. Free during early access; no card required.

posts.name: Hanzio
posts.tagline: Master Chinese characters with a dictionary and flashcards
posts.description: Hanzio is a free Chinese dictionary and study app that turns characters into long-term memory. Every word comes back four ways: type its meaning, type its pinyin, draw it from memory, and recognize it by ear. No self-grading, and each mode is scheduled on its own. The dictionary has 150,000+ entries with stroke order, character breakdowns, and frequency data. Plus, an HSK grammar and stories course and an offline camera scanner.

posts.name: AppSupa
posts.tagline: Find winning mobile app ideas with revenue data
posts.description: Before you build an app, check that it can make money. AppSupa shows what apps in any niche earn, which keywords people search that are still easy to rank for, and whether the top app is easy to beat: rated low, not updated in ages, or with few rivals. Search your idea, see the numbers, then decide. Revenue and download estimates for 590K+ App Store and Google Play apps, keyword demand and difficulty, and what users complain about in the top apps' reviews.

posts.name: IconMCP
posts.tagline: Fully autonomous icon library built by agents
posts.description: 6,249 original icons in outline and solid, and an MCP server your coding agent can search by meaning. Free for anything, MIT licence.

posts.name: Pause Kit
posts.tagline: Make better decisions under pressure
posts.description: Welcome, Product Hunt. Pause Kit is a free, private space to slow down before you react to a rude email, tense message or hard decision. Try it without an account.

posts.name: Lapline
posts.tagline: Lapline: training analysis and health tracker
posts.description: Training analysis for runners, and cyclists too. See your training load, trends, records and every session. Works with Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto and Wahoo.

posts.name: agileVERIFIED
posts.tagline: Evidence First Trust Platform
posts.description: Evidence-First Trust Platform. Bringing verified identity, relevant trust signals in a shareable Trust profile enabling Buyers to make informed decisions and Sellers to earn Trust!

posts.name: Bundle
posts.tagline: Remember what you read. A quiet home for your articles
posts.description: Bundle is a quiet place for everything you want to read. Save articles from your iPhone, your computer (Chrome extension) or an e-ink reader, and they all end up in one library. Read them offline, listen to them, or ask AI about what you're reading. At the end of each article you get a few flashcards to check you understood it. The cards are saved, and Bundle reminds you every day to review them, so you remember what you read.

posts.name: Loop
posts.tagline: Share any file in your brand, with tracking & signing.
posts.description: Drop a file and the link is copied. See every open, page and signature. Your logo, colours and domain on every link. Notes, markup and signatures, right on the page. Decide who sees it, and for how long. Screenshots and recordings, straight to a link. Ask for files with one link. Pay once. Own it forever.

posts.name: Bundle
posts.tagline: Remember what you read. A quiet home for your articles
posts.description: Bundle is a quiet place for everything you want to read. Save articles from your iPhone, your computer (Chrome extension) or an e-ink reader, and they all end up in one library. Read them offline, listen to them, or ask AI about what you're reading. At the end of each article you get a few flashcards to check you understood it. The cards are saved, and Bundle reminds you every day to review them, so you remember what you read.

posts.name: Drillloop
posts.tagline: Practice job interviews out loud with an AI that follows up
posts.description: Most interview prep is silent: you read questions, nod, and think you're ready. Then you say it out loud for the first time in the real interview. Drillloop is a voice interviewer that reads the job description and your resume, asks you questions out loud, and follows up on what you actually said. Camera on, like the real room. Up to 20 minutes, in five languages. After every interview you get a scored report: what landed, what didn't, and a stronger version of your answer.

posts.name: Pabo for iPhone
posts.tagline: Fake shopping, now on iPhone with a playable snail
posts.description: Product Hunt loved Pabo’s delivery snail, so I made him a game. Now on iPhone: shop 200+ imaginary products with pretend money, guide Pabo past rocks, unbox your order and decorate your room. Also on Android. Nothing in the catalog is real.

posts.name: Gmail Button Inserter for Emails
posts.tagline: Add CTA Buttons to Emails
posts.description: Add clickable CTA buttons to Gmail emails in one click. Email-safe buttons that look right in Outlook, Apple Mail and on mobile.

posts.name: Parser
posts.tagline: AI document parser for messy, real-world files
posts.description: Parser reads the documents that break ordinary extraction (scans, phone photos, handwriting, stamps, files up to 1,000 pages) and returns the fields you define as JSON, Excel or CSV, by upload, e-mail or REST API. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Fish
posts.tagline: Figma, in a single HMTL
posts.description: Fish is a vector design editor that lives entirely inside a single standalone HTML file. The editor and the design are sealed into one HTML file which you can save, edit and share. No installation, account, backend, or dependency fetch required. The design is stored as JSON embedded into the html -- That means an AI model can read the file, make structural changes, and return a file that still opens in the editor.

posts.name: NoSwipe
posts.tagline: Stop swiping. Let AI run your dating apps.
posts.description: Dating apps turned into a second job. Screenshot your Tinder, Hinge or Bumble profile or a chat that went quiet: NoSwipe rebuilds the profile, drafts openers and replies in your voice, and plans the first date. You edit and hit send. Early access.

posts.name: App TXT
posts.tagline: free app-ads.txt generator & hosting for apps
posts.description: Your app-ads.txt in one minute — Pick your ad networks, paste your Publisher IDs and download a valid file — or let us host it and keep it up to date for you. See who tests monetization with whom - The same DIRECT account of AdMob, Meta, AppLovin, Unity or LevelPlay on two sites means one ad account — a publishing deal, a partnership or a test. We read every checked app-ads.txt daily and record when shared accounts appear and disappear.

posts.name: Laudis
posts.tagline: ilmainen yo-harjoittelu ja vanhat yo-tehtävät
posts.description: Harjoittele pitkän matematiikan yo-koetta ilmaiseksi. Vanhat yo-tehtävät vuodesta 2004 alkaen, vastausten tarkistus ja malliratkaisut.

posts.name: HiringAnt
posts.tagline: AI interviewer that runs your first-round interviews
posts.description: AI interviewer for enterprise hiring teams: live voice first rounds with recording, transcript and a 0–100 score. Plus AI resume screening with reasons and a 3,000+ talent pool. For job seekers: AI job search across 15+ sources, Job Agents and mock interviews.

posts.name: AdAmigo.ai for Google Ads
posts.tagline: Your self-improving Facebook ads agent now runs Google too
posts.description: Your next AI hire: an AI ad agent that runs your Meta ads, and now Google Ads too. Connect both and see where you’re wasting spend, which winners you’re missing, and where your budget belongs. Every day it brings you fixes to approve in one click, or opt in to Autopilot. Chat with it to design ads, plan strategy or pull reports. Autopilot users see +32% on their main KPI within 30 days, and running your ads takes about an hour a week. 2,000+ ad accounts already run on it. Try it for free 🎉!

posts.name: Vita Health Coach
posts.tagline: Your parent's hospital records, explained, in one app
posts.description: Connect US hospitals once and keep each person's results in their own file: a parent, a partner, a child, you. Ask about any result in plain words, by voice or text, in 26 languages. The short answer comes first: can this wait, and how soon to see a doctor. It explains, never diagnoses. Records stay sealed on your iPhone.

posts.name: Study Saga
posts.tagline: A cozy Pomodoro timer that turns your focus into an RPG
posts.description: Study Saga is a free Pomodoro timer with 1,000+ lofi and synthwave tracks, animated scenes and live study rooms. Every focus session earns XP, join a faction and clear quests. Works on the web and inside Discord activity.

posts.name: Dray
posts.tagline: Shared memory for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and coding agents
posts.description: Every AI you pay for keeps its own memory, and none of them share it. Dray gives ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor one memory. Hit your Claude limit, open ChatGPT, and it can look up what you already decided. A browser extension saves your web chats and a CLI saves your coding sessions. Any MCP client can search it. $9 a month, full refund within 30 days. The extension needs Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave or Opera on a computer.

posts.name: CEOInterviews.AI
posts.tagline: What executives say on camera, verified and searchabe
posts.description: Search what CEOs and other leaders said on podcasts,at conferences and on TV, not just on earnings calls 250K+ verified transcripts back to 2006, with each urn attributed to the speaker, timestamped to the sorce and matched to the person and company. Human QA onfirms it's really them speaking. Built for investos, researchers and AI agents. Search and read 20 trascripts free. Paid plans add the API and MCP server.

posts.name: Be My Widget
posts.tagline: Become the Designer of Your Home Screen!
posts.description: Widgets, themes, and a design editor for Apple devices. Customize your Home Screen with 28+ useful widgets and 200+ handcrafted themes. Create your own styles with the built-in editor, pin photos from files or URLs, and use Be My Widget across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro, and CarPlay. 💚 Special annual offer for Product Hunt visitors below

posts.name: Postzora
posts.tagline: Write once, post everywhere, with team approvals built in
posts.description: Postzora is a social media scheduler for teams. Write a post once, tailor the text for each network, and see live previews before it goes out. Plan everything on one calendar across 14 networks, including X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads and Bluesky. Teammates send posts for approval, links can go in an automatic first comment, and RSS feeds turn new blog posts into scheduled posts. You can even schedule by asking Claude or ChatGPT.

posts.name: Eyrie
posts.tagline: A live map of your codebase for you and your AI agents
posts.description: Eyrie turns your repo into a live architecture map: UI, API, services, data and every outside service, found from the code. Save a file and only what moved updates. Ask questions in plain English and every answer must cite the graph. Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Muse Code) get the same map over MCP to check what an edit could break. 16 languages. Runs on your machine: no account, no telemetry. Free and open source.

posts.name: NLQueries
posts.tagline: Plain-English questions to SQL, validated before it runs
posts.description: NLQueries turns plain-English questions into SQL, checks it against your real schema, runs it read-only and shows the SQL with the answer. It learns from your query history, reads your docs too, and plugs into Claude Desktop or Cursor over MCP. Self-hosted.
